title: Solid Tooltip.svg Assets Not Used When Panel is Solid
line: With an opaque panel, its tooltips are now opaque too instead of letting the wallpaper show through.
explanation: Panel popups switch to the theme's solid/ SVGs when the containment sets ContainmentPrefersOpaqueBackground, but the shared tooltip window never looked at that hint, so it always used the translucent widgets/tooltip SVG. On top of that, PlasmaWindow::setBackgroundHints hardcoded dialogs/background, so setting the hint on a tooltip would have swapped in the dialog SVG. ToolTipArea now sets the tooltip's background hints from the owning applet's containment (looking past the system tray's embedded containment), and PlasmaWindow keeps the SVG it was created with, only adding the solid/ prefix.

commits.message:
tooltips: use the solid background when the panel is opaque

Tooltips ignored the containment's opaque background preference and
always used the translucent SVG. Set their hints from the containment,
and make PlasmaWindow keep its own SVG instead of dialogs/background.

BUG: 512154

media.caption: Opaque panel on master: the task manager tooltip is tinted pink by the red wallpaper.
With the fix: the same tooltip is opaque and matches the panel.
Opaque panel on master: a system tray (brightness) tooltip is also translucent.
With the fix: the tray tooltip is opaque too.
